name: Oryx Bookings
author: Rabie Eltegani

sections.description:
Oryx Bookings provides a robust infrastructure for managing service-based bookings on your WordPress site. Built with custom database tables for optimal performance and scalability.

Features

  • Custom database tables for efficient data storage.
  • Service management with categories.
  • Booking slot configuration.
  • Admin dashboard for managing bookings.
  • Internationalization ready (i18n).

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher.
  • PHP 8.0 or higher.

Usage

Adding a Booking Form

You can add a booking form to any page or post using the following shortcode:

[oryx_bookings]

This shortcode will display all available services with booking options. Users can select the service they want to book directly from the form.

Finding Service IDs

To find the ID of a service:
1. Go to Oryx Bookings > Services in your WordPress admin
2. Hover over any service name
3. The ID will appear in the URL or you can view it in the service details

Customizing the Form

The booking form automatically adapts to your theme’s styling. You can further customize it using CSS classes:
– .oryx-bookings-form – Main form container
– .oryx-bookings-field – Individual form fields
– .oryx-bookings-submit – Submit button

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following third-party libraries:

  • Flatpickr v4.6.13
    Source: https://flatpickr.js.org/
    Copyright (c) 2017 Gregory Petrosyan
    License: MIT License (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oryx-bookings folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Oryx Bookings menu in your WordPress admin to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I create a new service?

Navigate to Oryx Bookings > Services in your WordPress admin and click “Add New.”

Can I customize the booking form?

Yes, the plugin provides various options for customizing the booking form appearance and fields.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme?

Oryx Bookings is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.
